deploybot: :rotating_light: Rollback initiated for service `runtime-api` in `eu-west-1`

Details: env=eu-west-1, target=pinned->v1.12.3, current=v1.12.4 (sha=9a7b2c), trigger=canary spike (resp latency +5x). Initiating automated rollback and pin.

alex: What was the canary window that flagged this? Any error rates besides latency?

sara: Canary window is 10m. Errors are within normal (0.2%), latency p50 up 2.1x, p95 up 5.3x on model inference path. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/rt/runtime-api?orgId=1 :link:

miguel: Oncall here — I'll watch the rollback and hold the previous tag pinned. Running smoke after rollback. @deploybot please provide the exact revert deploy command & expected down-time.

deploybot: Executing revert sequence now. Steps run: 1) drain canary traffic 2) pin v1.12.3 3) deploy rollout to 100% 4) run smoke checks

Command (internal):
```bash
# automated by deploybot
deploybot revert --service runtime-api --env eu-west-1 --to-tag v1.12.3 --reason "canary-latency-spike" --pin prev
```

deploybot: Output:
```
[00:00:01] draining canary traffic... done
[00:00:12] updating k8s image to redwood/runtime-api:v1.12.3... started
[00:00:45] rollout 40%... healthy

```

ci-bot: CI: smoke suite passed (all checks green). Coverage unchanged.

miguel: Confirming pin is in place and I've set a temporary incident note in PagerDuty. Will monitor for 15m and then open a postmortem if anything reappears.

alex: Thanks. Can we record the release notes change and reason so product knows? I'll add a short blurb to the release thread.

sara: Adding quick metrics snapshot for archives: 
```
canary_window=10m
p50_before=120ms p50_after=260ms
p95_before=420ms p95_after=2300ms
errors=0.2% (no uptick)
```

ops-oncall: Marked as mitigated. Creating an action to run bisect on the v1.12.4 commits tomorrow morning (UTC).

miguel: One more note — we pinned the route to v1.12.3 and set a protective guard: auto-rollforward disabled for 2h. If we want to reattempt v1.12.4 we'll need explicit approval + canary tweak.

alex: Sounds good. Filing a brief release rollback note now. :memo:

deploybot: Rollback completed and pin enforced (v1.12.3). Thread closed but monitoring continues until 2026-03-15T12:30Z. If anyone needs to unpin, run `deploybot unpin --service runtime-api --env eu-west-1 --by <owner>` and tag the change.

sara: :thumbsup: thanks everyone.

miguel: leaving watch — will update if anything changes.
